source: Note: This game was designed for the standard 16:9 aspect ratio — ideally in fullscreen at 1080p. Due to the way text scales, especially in longer paragraphs, using other formats may result in minor display issues.
target: 注意：本游戏以标准16:9长宽比设计，建议使用1080p全萤幕模式。文字缩放方式可能使其他显示格式出现轻微的排版问题，尤其是较长的段落。

source: Note: This game was built for 1x speed. The pacing — from story beats to dialogue, from gameplay flow to how content unfolds — is all tuned for that tempo. For the clearest, most balanced experience, we recommend you play at 1x.
target: 注意：本游戏以1倍速设计。故事节奏、对话、游玩流程及内容展开速度，皆依此调整。为获得最清晰、均衡的体验，建议以1倍速游玩。
